jia: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel selection roll (float8 path enabled for mixtral-moex) we saw a regression on p50 token latency for 4k contexts. p50 went from ~68ms -> ~80ms on the same baseline load. anyone else observe this?
sam: saw the spike in dashboards, +18% p50, tail also crept up. coroutines backlog looked slightly higher.
morgan: I pulled a profile from the canary node (mixtral-moe-az1). main diff is more time in router softmax + top-k gather. attaching clipped snippet: ```top functions: 1) router_softmax 41.8% 2) expert_gather_topk 22.4% 3) kv_read_async 9.7% 4) fused_attention_kernel 6.1%```
jia: interesting — router_softmax dominating. Did kernel change modify softmax math (stable vs naive) or reduce vectorization?
leo: float8 kernels switched to our new reduce-loop that packs 32->8 lanes. It improved matmul earlier but we may have regressed for tiny softmax dims (k=64). I suspect reduced simd utilization when top-k selection is small.
sam: also saw more KV cache misses reported in the trace for some sessions. KV hit-rate dropped ~3% on long sessions (>=2048). Could float8 reduced-fp quantization be making some key mismatches?
morgan: KV is integer keys, so mismatch unlikely. But batching heuristics changed: the runtime switched to larger dynamic batch sizes to amortize matmul cost under float8. That increased per-request queueing before router-level splitting.
leo: reproduce plan: 1) rollback float8 softmax variant on one canary 2) force batching cap to old value (max 32 -> 16) 3) collect micro-profiles and kv hit histograms.
infra-bot: deploy triggered: rollback softmax-variant on mixtral-moe-canary-3 (sha: ae3f7c).
deply-bot: canary rollback completed; monitoring for 30m.
sam: quick comparison after rollback (10m window): p50 back to ~69ms, router_softmax fell to 18% of CPU. kv hit-rate unchanged in this short window.
jia: good signal. so two separate effects: softmax kernel variant and batching heuristic. we need a reproducible micro-benchmark. can we make a small harness: route-only + topk with synthetic sequences and measure kernel timings?
morgan: yes, I sketched a runner: ```./bench_router --model mixtral-moex --seq 4096 --batch 8 --topk 4 --profile=cpu``` Will push to infra-ml repo.
leo: also propose adding a tiny heuristic: if topk <= 8 use legacy softmax path optimized for small-k (vector-friendly), else float8 path. That may buy us perf without full rollback.
sam: +1 — also add an opt-in flag for batch-cap so Dedicated customers can pin to conservative batch.
jia: can we get numbers from micro-bench? target: router_softmax <= 20% CPU and p50 within 5% of baseline. Also capture kv cache hit distribution pre/post.
morgan: running bench now, pushing results in ~15m. preliminary: legacy softmax 1.8ms per call, float8 softmax 3.9ms for k=4. For k=64 float8 wins: 8.1ms vs legacy 12.4ms.
leo: exactly what I feared — crossover point at ~k=12-16. need adaptive kernel selection by topk.
sam: note: topk distribution in production skews very small (most routes use topk 1-8). so global default to float8 hurts more workflows.
jia: next steps: 1) add adaptive softmax selection in runtime (threshold tunable) 2) revert default kernel for mixtral-moex until threshold tuned 3) add batching cap config per deployment 4) collect kv histograms to rule out quantization KV effects.
morgan: I'll open a PR with adaptive switch + bench results. PR will include data showing p50, p95 per topk bucket.
leo: I'll draft a short change in the kernel selector: pseudo: ```if (topk <= K_THRESHOLD) use legacy_smallk_softmax(); else use float8_softmax();``` we'll make K_THRESHOLD config and autosuggest based on observed topk quantiles.
sam: also sanity-check: ensure topk path doesn't break routing deterministic tie-breaking; small differences could change expert fanout -> cache pressure.
jia: good catch. add unit tests that route identical logits through both paths and assert identical topk chosen (within tie-breaking semantics).
infra-bot: morgan opened PR #4128: "adaptive-softmax-selection + bench"
morgan: PR includes perf numbers and an opt-in runtime flag. request review from leo/sam/jia.
sam: review done, left comments about threshold config name and metrics tags (router.path:legacy|float8).
leo: I'll push a follow-up with threshold auto-suggest using production topk histogram.
jia: thanks — aim to roll to canary by EOD with monitoring dashboards showing bucketed p50/p95 and kv-hit charts.
morgan: noted. I'll also attach `perf` flamegraphs and raw bench logs to the PR.
